build.beforeDevCommand: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:* ws://127.0.0.1:5173; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'
